data.name: Russia
data.summary: Not a realistic option: sanctions, capital controls and suspended tax treaties make holding or moving a global portfolio from Russia impractical. On paper (from 2025), residents pay 13% on investment income (dividends, securities gains, property sales) up to RUB 2.4 million a year and 15% above. Property held more than the minimum period (3 or 5 years) is exempt on sale. Inheritances are not taxed, nor are gifts from family members and close relatives. There is no wealth tax.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Ordinary residence; worldwide income. From 2025 a five-band scale (13–22%) applies to the main tax base, and a separate 13%/15% scale applies to investment income.
regimes.eligibility: Tax resident after 183 days in Russia within 12 consecutive months (generally reported; not confirmed on the FNS page read). Foreigners need a residence permit.

capital_gains.summary: Income from the sale of securities and property is taxed at 13% up to RUB 2.4 million of such income a year and 15% above. Property (other than securities) owned longer than the minimum holding period, three years (five in some cases), is exempt. A long-term ownership exemption exists for certain securities held over five years (details not verified).

open_questions: Scope and caps of the long-term ownership exemption for securities (LDV) and any 2025 cap on the property-sale exemption were not verified.
Whether the minimum-holding-period exemption applies to foreign real estate was not verified.

Russia is subject to extensive EU, US, UK and other sanctions; Western brokers and banks generally will not service Russia-resident clients, Russian capital controls apply to residents of 'unfriendly' states, and Russia suspended key provisions of its tax treaties with many 'unfriendly' states in 2023 (Presidential Decree No. 585 of 8 Aug 2023 as widely reported; not verified here). A family holding a global portfolio cannot realistically relocate there.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Top investment-income rate 15% for securities and private company shares (long-term ownership exemption ignored as unverified). Local real estate held longer than the 3/5-year minimum: exempt (0). Foreign real estate left null.
capital_gains.holding_period_rules: Property: exempt after 3 years (5 years in other cases) of ownership.
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents taxed on worldwide income; treaty relief limited by the 2023 suspension of treaties with 'unfriendly' states (unverified).

dividends.summary: Resident individuals pay 13% on dividends up to RUB 2.4 million a year of investment income and 15% above. Foreign dividends are taxed at the same rates, with a credit for foreign tax where a treaty applies.

inheritance.summary: Russia has no inheritance tax: income received by inheritance is not taxable. Gifts from family members and close relatives (spouses, parents, children, grandparents, grandchildren, full and half siblings) are also exempt. Gifts of real estate, vehicles or shares from others are taxable income.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Median asking rent of 360 distinct long-term listings (interquartile range RUB 328,000-700,000) of 4-5 room flats for rent in Moscow's Central Administrative Okrug (Khamovniki, Presnensky, Tverskoy, Arbat, Basmanny, Zamoskvorechye, Yakimanka and others) on Cian, snapshot 2026-10-15. Cian reported 839 matching listings; 441 could be read (21 result pages) and duplicates with the same rooms, area and price were removed. All priced per month (lease term 'longTerm'). Asking rents, not agreed rents; Russian room counts include the living room, so a 4-room flat has about 3 bedrooms and 5 rooms about 4. Flats, not houses: villas are let in the Rublyovka suburbs outside the sample. Checked 2026-10-15 against the upper-middle-class standard.

intl_school_annual_fee.description: International School of Moscow (Nord Anglia; Krylatskoe and Rosinka campuses), Year 12 full-year tuition 2026-27: EUR 47,900 (EUR 46,942 if paid before 15 June). The fee table groups Year 12 with Year 13 (IB Diploma); Year 13 is not printed separately. Fees are quoted in EUR but must be paid in RUB at the Central Bank of Russia rate on the payment date, at no less than 90 RUB/EUR. Extra: compulsory lunch EUR 1,970 a year; one-off enrolment fee RUB 600,000 and application fee RUB 50,000. The Anglo-American School of Moscow closed in 2023, so ISM is used.
